_comment: GM/leak-tester only. Never load from character-agent or player-facing code. Canaries are phrase-level (not single common words) to reduce false positives, except for the two proper nouns that are genuinely rare in ordinary dialogue: 'Study' (as the true murder room) and 'Storage Room' (as the Ammonite's hiding place). NOTE: canaries here assume a fresh/isolated probe context, before any fact has been legitimately unlocked via disclosure.py's tiered rules -- see the design-note caveat in the final report about re-scoping these once a fact is properly disclosed in-scene.
